## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
You should surface report-write failures because an unavailable destination currently produces a success message and return code.

## Changes
The pull request adds report saving, destination announcements, and cleanup that tolerates absent temporary reports. This review read the added tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Propagate write failures before announcing success — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` swallows `FileNotFoundError`, prints “Report saved,” and returns zero despite creating no report. The `except OSError` also discards permission and disk-write errors. — Users and calling automation receive a false success signal and cannot identify why the requested report was not saved.
